name: Tendō (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Tendō city emblem in white: a stylised bird with outstretched wings above a loop.
history: Municipal flag of Tendō, a city in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 13 December 1989; the emblem dates from 1 April 1963.

features.role: Tendō city emblem — a stylised bird with outstretched wings above a loop
